title: Repository assurance improvement opportunities governance
purpose: Summarise discovery-only assurance improvement opportunities before future UI and staging work expands USF app-surface risk.

authorityBoundary.notes: This artifact closes planning criteria only. It does not create validators, tests, scans, dependencies, or proof claims.

opportunities.name: Validator regression-proofing before UI work
opportunities.authorityOrProofNeed: Validator rules must continue to fail closed when app-surface work adds schemas, generated clients, environment proof, or evidence classes.
opportunities.falsePositiveRisk: Over-broad affected-validation or stale parse caches can produce false passes.

opportunities.name: Generated client pipeline readiness
opportunities.authorityOrProofNeed: Generated clients must trace to active or explicitly authorised contracts with reproducible outputs and conformance evidence.
opportunities.falsePositiveRisk: Generated output can look current while source contracts, lifecycle state, or generator inputs have drifted.

opportunities.name: App-surface proof integration readiness
opportunities.authorityOrProofNeed: UI changes must map to provider mode, environment, proof level, and retained artifact expectations.
opportunities.falsePositiveRisk: Hermetic mock or production-shaped proof can be mistaken for live external provider or production-live proof.

assuranceGapCategories.category: Medium risk conformance and drift assurance

opportunities.name: Contract conformance and API client drift checks
opportunities.authorityOrProofNeed: Contract tests and generated-client checks must compare outputs against governed source contracts.
opportunities.falsePositiveRisk: Stale generated clients or planned-only schemas can satisfy local tests without satisfying governed semantics.

opportunities.name: Deterministic generated outputs and reproducible build policy
opportunities.authorityOrProofNeed: Generated projections and build artifacts require source hashes, generator metadata, cache keys, and deterministic comparison rules.
opportunities.falsePositiveRisk: Cache hits can hide changed generator inputs or source contract drift.

opportunities.name: Semantic-to-implementation and test-to-requirement traceability
opportunities.authorityOrProofNeed: Implementation and tests must trace to semantic definitions, ADRs, validators, and proof evidence rather than source resemblance.
opportunities.falsePositiveRisk: Trace links can become decorative unless validators fail missing or unknown trace classes closed.

assuranceGapCategories.category: Medium risk supply-chain and security assurance

opportunities.name: SBOM, licence policy, vulnerability scan, and provenance gates
opportunities.authorityOrProofNeed: Dependency and generated-client consumption must preserve supply-chain evidence and frozen install integrity.
opportunities.falsePositiveRisk: Scanner noise or unsupported severity thresholds can create false blockers without authority linkage.

opportunities.name: Secret scan and environment simulation checks
opportunities.authorityOrProofNeed: Environment proof must preserve provider/environment separation and prevent secret leakage in artifacts or generated reports.
opportunities.falsePositiveRisk: Pattern-based secret scans can flag examples or miss generated artifacts if scope is unclear.

opportunities.name: Validator property-based test pilots
opportunities.authorityOrProofNeed: Property tests can broaden invariant coverage for vocabularies, taxonomies, schema lifecycle, evidence status, and provider/environment separation.
opportunities.falsePositiveRisk: Unbounded generators, nondeterministic seeds, or expensive shrinking can create flaky gates.

opportunities.name: Dead-tool, stale-guidance, and duplicate-content audits
opportunities.authorityOrProofNeed: Repository hygiene improves agent safety but must not remove authority, proof, validator, or lineage evidence without separate validation.
opportunities.falsePositiveRisk: Similarity or stale-candidate labels can be wrong if authority role and references are not checked.

uiBlockingAssuranceItems: Contract conformance and generated API client drift checks.
Deterministic generated output and cache-key policy for UI-consumed artifacts.
Environment and provider-mode proof separation for app-surface flows.
Secret and environment leakage checks for UI proof artifacts.
falsePositiveRiskControls: Every future assurance gate should state the authority or proof need it protects before enforcement.
Negative controls, planted defects, or equivalent failure fixtures should be included where applicable.
Generated reports must remain lower authority and cannot satisfy raw evidence or semantic authority requirements alone.
No scanner, validator, or proof command should be considered UI-blocking until scope, false-positive handling, owner, and rollback are defined.
Flaky, nondeterministic, stale-cache, or unknown-input conditions fail closed to the broader validation gate rather than producing pass evidence.

coveredIssues.title: Parent: Assurance improvement opportunities
coveredIssues.completionBasis: assuranceGapCategories, uiBlockingAssuranceItems, and falsePositiveRiskControls satisfy the parent planning criteria.

criteria: Assurance gaps are categorized by risk.
Each opportunity links to authority or proof need.
